entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:1
segments: But as to the times and the moments, there is no need, Brothers, for any one to write to you.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:2
segments: You yourselves know well that the Day of the Lord will come just as a thief comes in the night.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:3
segments: When people are saying 'All is quiet and safe,' it is then that, like birth-pains upon a woman with child, Ruin comes suddenly upon them, and there will be no escape!

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:4
segments: You, however, Brothers, are not in darkness, that the daylight should take you by surprise as if you were thieves.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:5
segments: For you all are 'Sons of Light' and 'Sons of the Day.' We have nothing to do with night, or darkness.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:6
segments: Therefore let us not sleep as others do. No, let us be watchful and self-controlled.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:7
segments: It is at night that men sleep, and at night that drunkards get drunk.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:8
segments: But let us, who belong to the Day, control ourselves, and put on faith and love as a breast plate, and the hope of Salvation as a helmet.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:9
segments: For God destined us, not for Wrath, but to win Salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ, who died for us,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:10
segments: That, whether we are still watching or have fallen asleep, we may live with him.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:11
segments: Therefore encourage one another, and try to build up one another's characters, as indeed you are doing.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:12
segments: We beg you, Brothers, to value those who toil among you, and are your leaders in the Lord's service, and give you counsel.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:13
segments: Hold them in the very greatest esteem and affection for the sake of their work. Live at peace with one another.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:14
segments: We entreat you also, Brothers--warn the disorderly, comfort the faint-hearted, give a helping hand to the weak, and be patient with every one.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:15
segments: Take care that none of you ever pays back wrong for wrong, but always follow the kindest course with one another and with every one.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:16
segments: Always be joyful;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:17
segments: Never cease to pray;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:18
segments: Under all circumstances give thanks to God. For this is his will for you as made known in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:19
segments: Do not quench the Spirit;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:20
segments: Do not make light of preaching.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:21
segments: Bring everything to the test; cling to what is good;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:22
segments: Shun every form of evil.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:23
segments: May God himself, the giver of peace, make you altogether holy; and may your spirits, souls, and bodies be kept altogether faultless until the Coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:24
segments: He who calls you will not fail you; he will complete his work.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:25
segments: Brothers, pray for us.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:26
segments: Greet all the Brothers with a sacred kiss.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:27
segments: I adjure you in the Lord's name to have this letter read to all the Brethren.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:28
segments: May the blessing of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
